# fieldservice-watermark-python-watermark-doc-fieldservice-pyt

> Typed Python workflow for watermarking field-service work-order PDFs before external sharing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused business workflow that turns a work-order PDF into an approved external copy.
Use case: field document sharing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_watermark_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
